mandate.objective: Improve the usefulness and clarity of the approved operating document. Decide which evidence, participants, alternatives and correction are worth pursuing.
mandate.success_criteria: Investigate the supplied source, compare reasonable alternatives, record an attributable initiative and decision. Propose at most one useful exact document correction if justified, wait for separate owner approval, inspect its receipt and observed state, schedule and complete a second evidence-driven review.
mandate.stop_criteria: Stop after the second scheduled review, or if no useful safe correction can be justified. Never invent business impact.
mandate.constraints: All product/provider data is SIMULATED. No actual repository, website, customer, money, account or release is accessible. Only the exact fixture document grant exists. Internal analysis or a working group is optional where useful. The company chooses the conclusion and literal edit. After a confirmed fixture action, retrieve an operational observation and persist a follow-up 90–120 seconds after the first cycle closes; use current clock_now. Cycle 2 must read prior decision, exact receipt and new observation, assess costs/limitations and decide continue/iterate/pivot/stop. Stop this two-cycle test after the review; a stop decision is an acceptance resource bound, not a required favorable business conclusion.
mandate.resources: At most 40 reserved model executions per cycle; one group and two internal analysis Tasks. No public research grant or spending. Model token usage is retained when available; monetary cost is unknown.
